items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And he would call me Gussie... I had to straighten him out over in Europe

ctx.x: And he would call me Gussie, and I'd say, 'Call me Gus and not Gussie. Don't call me by any other name, see. Just call me Gus.' And he would always come up with this Gussie stuff. And I had to straighten him out over in Europe, see. And so did the bass player had to straighten him out, too.
